subject: Throughput Safeguard Addendum and Transition Plan
messages:
From: Diana Holt <diana.holt@finara.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected tail latency spike yesterday — need expedited SLA addendum

Hi Soojin,

We saw a significant tail-latency spike across our production inference path yesterday (2026-11-17 21:45 UTC) that impacted several customer-facing flows. The platform recovered, but the incident caused an operational page and a handful of client complaints. I attached the log extract.

Given our renewal window next month, Finara leadership is nervous about renewing without clearer uptime/throughput guarantees and a more deterministic mitigation path for incidents like this. Specifically, we need:
- A temporary throughput safeguard (cap + reserved headroom) while we validate migration to the 2.0 model variant
- An addendum that commits to a 99.95% monthly uptime SLA for the critical inference route, with defined remediation steps and a credit schedule for missed SLOs
- A shorter escalation timeline (30 minutes for priority incidents) and named contacts

Can Redwood provide an expedited addendum draft and a commercial path for a short-term premium pilot? We prefer not to pause the renewal discussion, but we need tangible commitments before our procurement team will sign.

Thanks,
Diana Holt
Head of Product Operations, Finara
Diana.Holt@finara.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachment: error_report_20261117.log (log excerpt, 2.3MB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Diana Holt <diana.holt@finara.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected tail latency spike yesterday — need expedited SLA addendum

Hi Diana — thanks for the heads up and for the detailed log.

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Diana Holt <diana.holt@finara.com> wrote:
> We saw a significant tail-latency spike across our production inference path yesterday ...

We take this seriously. Immediate plan from our side:
1) Activate a temporary throughput safeguard for Finara (reserved headroom + soft cap) within 24 hours to stabilize tail latency while we run targeted mitigations.
2) Stand up a dedicated incident pager rotation and shorten escalation SLA to 30 minutes for priority incidents during the pilot period.
3) Share an expedited addendum draft today that outlines the 99.95% uptime commitment, credit schedule, and termination/transition language for the pilot.

I attached a first-pass addendum and a short transition checklist for the migration to the 2.0 model variant. Pricing/credits are omitted in this draft — Ben will propose the commercials.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow at 11:00am PT to align on scope and timing? If that works, I’ll include our Solutions/Engineering lead.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed-addendum-v1.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected tail latency spike — commercial options for Finara

Soojin / Team — quick commercial overlay for the addendum and pilot: 

Summary bullets:
- Short-term premium pilot (30 days) with reserved capacity + throughput safeguard: estimated incremental cost = $18k/week (covers reserved GPU headroom and priority routing).
- SLA upgrade to 99.95% for the protected inference route; if missed, credit = pro-rata percentage of monthly committed spend up to 50% for severe breaches.
- We can offer a one-time reliability credit of $12k for the incident as a gesture upon signing the addendum.

Options for procurement:
- Option A (Fast): 30-day pilot, 3 business-day DocuSign turnaround, immediate activation of safeguard (requires PO or billing approval).
- Option B (Standard): 90-day pilot with phased migration and incremental monthly billing; lower weekly incremental cost.

I’ll prepare a clean commercial schedule and push a DocuSign envelope once Soojin confirms the option.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Action items:
- Soojin: confirm preferred option so I can finalize numbers.
- Marissa: prepare SLO language for legal review (I flagged a few change requests inline in the draft).
From: Diana Holt <diana.holt@finara.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finara.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected tail latency spike — commercial options for Finara

Thanks, Soojin and Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround.

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 4:00 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Summary bullets: - Short-term premium pilot ...

We’re open to Option A (30-day pilot) provided two things:
1) The addendum explicitly states there will be no penalty to Finara for de-prioritizing traffic during the pilot migration window;
2) Procurement needs a 30-day trial clause and a procurement contact listed in the DocuSign package.

procurement@finara.com will coordinate the PO. Can you update the draft with the trial clause and send the DocuSign link for internal review? We also need the named escalation contacts and phone numbers in the addendum.

Diana

Attachment referenced: error_report_20261117.log (from earlier)
